title: Add Vitest test suite and refactor for testability
summary: Introduced a Vitest-based test suite with coverage tooling and refactored the codebase for testability. The relay server was split into attachRelay/startServer/stopServer with named exports so tests can run on ephemeral ports without binding on import. Extracted audio-codec.js (frame conversion, noise gate) and util.js modules. Added unit/integration tests for server, relay, audio, worklets, and helpers, plus graphify knowledge-graph output and tooling configs.
userVisibleChange: No end-user behavior change; adds developer test infrastructure (npm test / test:cov / test:watch).
